# Kronos Fusion Energy — Whitepaper Library
> 104 design-and-physics whitepapers; each traces to an open, reproducible deposit (CC BY 4.0).

- [The Machine That Fathers the Sun-Fuel: Why Kronos Builds the Breeder First](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP001_breeder-first.html): Every fusion economy needs a fuel supply before it needs a power plant. Hyperion is the fuel supply.
- [Small by Geometry: The Aspect-Ratio-2.5 Spherical Tokamak](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP002_spherical-tokamak-a25.html): A fatter torus wins more plasma pressure from every tesla &mdash; that is the whole compactness case.
- [Solved, Not Scaled: Where Q = 3.424 Actually Comes From](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP003_gain-solved-not-scaled.html): The most important thing about Hyperion's gain is how it was obtained, not how large it is.
- [The Breeder's Design Point, on One Card](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP004_design-point.html): One operating point, every subsystem checked against the same numbers.
- [9.86 Million Amps: Current as a Buildability Choice](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP005_one-third-iter-current.html): Plasma current is the hardest engineering bill in a tokamak, and Hyperion's is set by its compact geometry.
- [Denser Than SPARC: Heating Power Density as the Real Metric](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP006_power-density.html): How hard a fusion core works is measured per cubic metre, and Hyperion works hard.
- [No Heroics Required: Confinement at H98 = 1.0](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP007_confinement-h98-one.html): Hyperion's gain does not depend on beating the confinement scaling law &mdash; only on meeting it.
- [Breeding Ratio Is a Lever, Not a Constant](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP008_tbr-lever.html): How much tritium Hyperion makes per tritium burned is a design choice, and the design chose 1.8.
- [Three Products From One Plasma: Tritium, Helium-3, Neutrons](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP009_three-streams.html): Hyperion is a foundry, not a generator &mdash; and it makes three materials the United States cannot source at scale.
- [The 14 MeV Neutron a Mirror Cannot Make](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP010_14mev-neutrons.html): Materials qualification needs fusion-spectrum neutrons, and only the D-T breeder produces them at rate.
- [Sized to the Requirement: Tritium at 1.87-4.0 kg/yr](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP011_tritium-to-requirement.html): Hyperion is built to a stated national tritium need, not to whatever a physics optimum happens to yield.
- [How a Tritium Machine Makes Helium-3](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP012_helium3-coproduct.html): The burner's scarce fuel is a free decay product of the breeder's primary output.
- [Declaring the Ash: Why f_He4 = 0.05 Is Printed, Not Buried](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP013_declared-ash.html): The number under the gain is the helium ash fraction &mdash; and Kronos writes it down.
- [Capacity Factor: Damage-Life-Limited, Not Duty-Limited](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP014_duty-cycle.html): Hyperion runs steady-state, so its uptime is set by how long the first wall survives, not by a pulse cycle.
- [A Four-Year Build, by Precedent](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP015_four-year-build.html): Hyperion's schedule is anchored to a real compact-HTS device, not to an aspiration.
- [Fuel Follows Purpose: Why the Breeder Burns D-T](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP016_fuel-follows-purpose.html): Hyperion and the burners run different fuels on purpose &mdash; each fuel chosen for what the machine must do.
- [Inside Existing Practice: Hyperion's Tritium Inventory](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP017_tritium-inventory-licensing.html): The breeder's radiological posture is bounded by design to stay inside civil licensing practice.
- [Gain Only: The Milestone Hyperion Does Not Need to Clear](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP018_gain-only-bar.html): The breeder is buildable because it is excused from the hardest bar in fusion &mdash; net electricity.
- [HTS Magnets for a Compact Core](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP019_hts-magnets-breeder.html): High-temperature superconducting tape is what lets a 1.2-metre machine reach reactor conditions.
- [Designing to a Requirement, Not an Optimum](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP020_sized-to-requirement.html): The most consequential choice in Hyperion is a philosophy: build what is needed, not what is maximal.
- [One Generator, Two Housings: Aegis and MetroVolt](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP021_two-housings-one-machine.html): Aegis and MetroVolt are the same D-3He mirror in two markets &mdash; not two machines.
- [Open Field Lines: Why the Burner Is a Mirror](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP022_why-a-mirror.html): The burner's signature move is to let the plasma leak &mdash; on purpose, into a converter.
- [The Locked Mode M Closing Point: Q_E 1.31, On One Hard Requirement](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP023_reference-point.html): The burner has a reproducible closing point &mdash; contingent on an end-plug density that is specified, not yet demonstrated.
- [The One Number That Decides Closure: Plug Density Ratio](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP024_binding-requirement.html): Not field, not size, not fuel mix &mdash; the burner's fate rests on the end-plug density ratio.
- [Length Sets Size, Not Closure](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP025_length-sets-size.html): The mirror's central-cell length is a free knob &mdash; it changes power and footprint, not whether the machine works.
- [Aegis: The Defense Housing of the Burner](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP026_aegis-card.html): Aegis is the defense configuration &mdash; resilient, fuel-logistics-free power for fixed installations.
- [MetroVolt: The Data-Center Housing of the Burner](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP027_metrovolt-card.html): MetroVolt is the commercial configuration &mdash; firm, carbon-free campus power with no steam cycle and no long-lived waste.
- [Fixed Site, Not Shipboard: A Computed Negative Kept in the Open](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP028_fixed-site-not-shipboard.html): The naval-propulsion version of Aegis does not fit in a hull &mdash; and Kronos published the reason.
- [A Generator on 1.66 Acres](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP029_footprint.html): The burner's folded footprint is small enough to site where power is actually needed.
- [17 Tesla, Already Built: The Mirror Throat Field](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP030_throat-field-17t.html): The burner's high-field magnets sit on a demonstrated number, not an extrapolated one.
- [Beta 0.55, Inside What GDT Measured](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP031_beta-055.html): The burner runs at a plasma pressure fraction experiments have already reached.
- [The Mirror-Ratio Penalty, Settled: 1.21x, Not 3.3x](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP032_mirror-ratio-settled.html): A worry that the burner's confinement carried a hidden penalty turned out to be overstated by design.
- [How a Mirror Holds Plasma: Pastukhov and the Confining Potential](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP033_pastukhov-confinement.html): The burner's confinement is electrostatic &mdash; a potential hill the plasma must climb to escape.
- [Solved, Not Assumed: The Electron Temperature](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP034_electron-temperature-solved.html): The burner's electron temperature is an output of the power balance, and it is not equal to the ion temperature.
- [The Charged-Power Budget: Why Open Systems Are Different](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP035_charged-power-budget.html): A mirror must pay its end losses out of charged power &mdash; and that single fact governs the burner.
- [Why Pure Deuterium Does Not Close in a Mirror](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP036_why-dd-fails.html): Deuterium-only fuel has better mirror confinement than D-3He &mdash; and still cannot close. Here is why.
- [The Closure Window: Helium-3 Fraction 0.20 to 0.43](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP037_closure-boundary.html): There is a fuel-mix window in which the burner closes &mdash; bounded on both sides, and published.
- [The Fuel Mix Is a Neutron Knob &mdash; and the Machine Gets Cleaner With Time](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP038_fuel-mix-lever.html): Raising the helium-3 fraction cuts neutron output ~4x across the closure window &mdash; and one step is free in gain.
- [An Interior Optimum: Ion Temperature at 80-100 keV](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP039_ion-temperature-optimum.html): The burner's ion temperature has a real peak, not a monotone trend &mdash; and the design sits on it.
- [Wide in Nine of Ten Parameters &mdash; and That Is the Problem](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP040_operating-window.html): The burner is not a knife-edge. Its trouble is the opposite: most knobs barely matter.
- [Unchannelled on Purpose: No Speculative Physics in the Baseline](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP041_unchannelled-baseline.html): The burner's baseline assumes zero alpha channelling &mdash; because no one has ever measured it.
- [A Reproducible Closing Point, and the One Requirement It Rests On](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP042_experiment-not-power-plant.html): The burner has a locked, reproducible closing point (Q_E 1.31) &mdash; honest that its closure is a requirement, not yet demonstrated.
- [Low-Neutron, Never Aneutronic: A Few Percent Is Small and It Is Not Zero](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP043_low-neutron-never-aneutronic.html): The burner's fuel is quiet, not silent &mdash; and the language stays honest about the difference.
- [The Neutron Fraction Is Not a Fuel Constant](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP044_fn-not-a-constant.html): How neutronic the burner is depends on how well it confines &mdash; a coupling most models miss entirely.
- [The Coupling Nobody Models: Better Confinement, More Neutrons](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP045_confinement-neutron-coupling.html): Improving the plasma's confinement raises its neutron output &mdash; a trade the design has to hold in view.
- [The Gentle Wall: Far Below the Breeder's Neutron Load](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP046_gentle-wall.html): A low-neutron fuel gives the burner a first wall that is comfortable, not consumable.
- [D-3He Versus D-T: The Neutron Budget Compared](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP047_dhe3-vs-dt-budget.html): Choosing the fuel is choosing the plant you must build around it &mdash; and the neutron budget is the fork.
- [Tuning the Neutron Output From the Fuel Line](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP048_fuel-mix-neutron-knob.html): The burner's neutron production is set decades in advance, at the fuel mix &mdash; and it is adjustable.
- [The Secondary Burn: Where the Burner's Neutrons Come From](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP049_tritium-burnup.html): The burner breeds a little tritium and burns 17% of it &mdash; and that secondary D-T is a real neutron source.
- [No Breeding Blanket: The Component the Burner Deletes](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP050_no-breeding-blanket.html): Because the burner does not run on tritium, it needs no blanket to breed it &mdash; and that removes a whole plant.
- [Quiet Structures: Activation and the Low-Level-Waste Path](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP051_activation-llw.html): Fewer neutrons means less activated steel &mdash; and a decommissioning stream that fits existing disposal.
- [Designed to Die of Old Age: Materials Dose Over Plant Life](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP052_materials-dose-life.html): The burner's wall is engineered to reach the end of the plant's life, not to be swapped on a cycle.
- [Two Neutrons, Two Purposes: 2.45 MeV Versus 14 MeV](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP053_neutron-mirror-cannot-make.html): The burner's neutrons are the wrong energy for materials testing &mdash; on purpose. That job belongs to the breeder.
- [The Breeder Is Neutron-Rich on Purpose](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP054_breeder-deliberately-neutronic.html): One machine in the family wants neutrons &mdash; and designs to make them at full rate.
- [Tritium-Lean by Design: A Trace Species in the Burner](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP055_tritium-lean-burner.html): The isotope that dominates fusion licensing is only a fleeting trace in the burner.
- [Shielding a Quiet Machine](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP056_shielding-low-neutron.html): Fewer neutrons means thinner shields, lighter structures, and more of the machine doing useful work.
- [The Maintenance Dividend of Low Neutrons](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP057_maintenance-dividend.html): The quiet fuel's biggest payoff is not physics &mdash; it is the outages that never have to happen.
- [Neutron Provenance: Every Channel Computed From Cross Sections](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP058_neutron-provenance.html): The burner's neutron budget is not a literal in a file &mdash; it is derived, channel by channel.
- [Electricity Without the Steam Detour](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP059_electricity-without-steam.html): When fusion energy arrives as charged particles, you can collect it like electricity &mdash; because it already is.
- [The Expander: Turning a Beam Into a Collectible Sheet](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP060_expander-end-tank.html): Before the burner can convert its exhaust, it has to spread it out &mdash; that is what the expander does.
- [The Number That Feeds the Converter: Directed Fraction 0.648](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP061_directed-fraction.html): How much of the burner's power arrives as collectible directed energy is a computed value &mdash; with synchrotron charged.
- [0.871 Is a Ceiling, Not a Design Value](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP062_ceiling-not-design.html): A flattering directed-fraction number exists in the record &mdash; and the design refuses to use it.
- [Handling the Heat: 3.7 MW/m2 on the End Wall](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP063_end-wall-heat.html): The burner's exhaust has to land somewhere &mdash; and where it lands is engineered to survive it.
- [Electron Direct Conversion: A Named Gate, Not an Assumption](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP064_electron-dec-gate.html): One of the two things standing between the burner and net electricity is a converter that must be demonstrated.
- [The Dominant Loss: Synchrotron Radiation at Half the Fusion Power](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP065_synchrotron-dominant-loss.html): The single largest energy loss in the burner is not the end leak &mdash; it is the light the electrons emit.
- [Bracketing the Uncertainty: Trubnikov, AFJ, and the Optically-Thin Bound](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP066_synchrotron-bracket.html): The burner does not trust one synchrotron formula &mdash; it publishes the whole bracket, including the one that fails.
- [Survival by Reabsorption: The Burner's Most Consequential Assumption](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP067_reabsorption.html): The design closes only because the plasma reabsorbs most of its own synchrotron light &mdash; and that fraction is unmeasured.
- [Bremsstrahlung, Cross-Checked](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP068_bremsstrahlung-crosscheck.html): The burner's second radiation channel is computed two ways, and the design uses the more cautious one.
- [Recirculating Power: What the Plug Costs the Plant](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP069_recirculating-power.html): The burner spends a large fraction of its own output keeping the plug alive &mdash; and that spend is the ledger's crux.
- [Converter Efficiency in the Window](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP070_converter-efficiency-window.html): The direct converter's efficiency matters &mdash; but not as much as the one parameter that actually decides closure.
- [Diversified Power Handling: Directed, Radiated, and Residual](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP071_multi-modal-harvest.html): The burner does not rely on a single conversion path &mdash; it collects power in several complementary ways.
- [Honest Lower Bounds: The Energy Convention the Ledger Uses](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP072_lower-bound-convention.html): Where the physics was ambiguous, the burner chose the convention that understates its own output.
- [Fuel Follows Purpose, Not Platform](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP073_fuel-follows-purpose-cycle.html): The whole family's fuel logic reduces to one rule &mdash; and the fuel cycle is where it plays out.
- [Helium-3: The Burner's Fuel, the Breeder's Co-Product](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP074_helium3-both-sides.html): The scarcest input in the family is made by one member and consumed by the others.
- [The Burner's Helium-3 Appetite](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP075_he3-demand-card-scale.html): The burners' demand for helium-3 is large enough to be the enabling condition of the whole product line.
- [The External Gate: Lunar Helium-3](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP076_lunar-helium3.html): The commercial burner fleet's largest dependency is not physics at all &mdash; it is where the fuel comes from.
- [Stockpile That Ripens: Tritium Decay to Helium-3](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP077_tritium-decay-he3.html): Every gram of tritium is a slow helium-3 factory &mdash; and the rate is a known physical constant.
- [Breeding Fuel in the Burner: The D-D Helium-3 Channel](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP078_in-situ-breeding.html): The burner makes a little of its own helium-3 as it runs &mdash; a partial, honestly-bounded credit.
- [Breeding at 1.8: How Hyperion Makes More Than It Burns](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP079_tbr-in-hyperion.html): The breeder's surplus tritium is the whole point &mdash; and the breeding ratio is a design lever set to 1.8.
- [Tritium to the National Requirement](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP080_tritium-national-requirement.html): The breeder's primary product answers a supply gap the United States cannot currently fill at scale.
- [Tritium-Lean: The Burner's Fuel-Cycle Discipline](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP081_tritium-lean-cycle.html): The burner holds almost no tritium &mdash; a fuel-cycle property, not a safety add-on.
- [Carried at Zero: The Unpriced Neutron Stream](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP082_he3-unpriced-stream.html): One of the breeder's products has no market price anywhere in the world &mdash; so the programme books it at zero.
- [Sequencing the Fuel: A Breeder Decade Feeds the Demonstrator](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP083_sequencing-breeder-fuels-demo.html): The programme's order is a fuel-supply argument &mdash; make the fuel first, burn it later.
- [A Self-Fuelled Demonstrator: ~10 MWe on the Breeder's Decay Helium-3](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP084_burner-waits-for-2036-fuel.html): The first burner is a ~10 MWe Aegis demonstrator, sized to the helium-3 the breeder's own tritium decays into.
- [The Fusion Company That Shows Its Work](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP085_shows-its-work.html): Kronos's differentiator is not a claim about performance &mdash; it is a commitment to candor.
- [Frozen Points and Recorded Withdrawals](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP086_frozen-points-recorded-withdrawals.html): A frozen number at Kronos is a commitment against silent change &mdash; not a claim of final truth.
- [Reproduced From Source: Eleven of Eleven Checks](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP087_reproduce-from-source.html): Before a number is frozen, it is re-derived from its origin &mdash; and the re-derivation is logged.
- [Bit-Exact: Verifying Against the Prior Evaluator](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP088_bit-exact-verification.html): When the burner's new solver replaced the old one, it first reproduced the old one exactly &mdash; then corrected it.
- [Declared Basis Over Silent Basis](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP089_declared-over-silent.html): The recurring lesson in the Kronos record is not about arithmetic &mdash; it is about stating your assumptions.
- [Named Gates, Not Hidden Assumptions](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP090_named-gates.html): Every Kronos machine states the specific things that must be demonstrated before it works.
- [Labeled History: Superseded Values Are Kept, Not Deleted](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP091_labeled-history.html): When a Kronos number changes, the old one stays in the record with an era label &mdash; on purpose.
- [Deterministic by Construction: No Randomness in the Answer](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP092_deterministic-solves.html): The burner's design point is a solve on a fixed grid &mdash; run it again and you get the same number.
- [Naming the Largest Open Item](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP093_largest-open-item.html): The burner's design record points directly at its own biggest weakness &mdash; and calls it the next track's job.
- [Cross-Checks From Independent Physics](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP094_independent-crosschecks.html): The burner's headline gain is trusted because a different method reached nearly the same number.
- [Read the Limitations First](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP095_read-limitations-first.html): The burner's design record asks you to read its caveats before quoting anything above them.
- [Safety Posture: A Trace Source Term and No Repository](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP096_safety-posture.html): The burner's low-neutron fuel makes its safety case categorically different from a D-T plant's.
- [Licensing Posture of a Low-Neutron Plant](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP097_licensing-posture.html): The burner's biggest schedule advantage may be regulatory, and it comes straight from the fuel choice.
- [An Experiment, Not a Power Plant: The Founder's Baseline](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP098_experiment-not-power-plant-method.html): The phrase that governs every Kronos claim is a refusal to call an experiment a power plant.
- [Sensitivity Published, Not Buried](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP099_sensitivity-published.html): Kronos ranks its parameters by how much they matter &mdash; and publishes the ranking, inconvenient entries included.
- [Open Deposit: Data and Code, Not Just Claims](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP100_open-deposit.html): Every headline number in the Kronos record traces to deposited data and runnable code.
- [Breeder Physics Closed; Burner Closing Point Locked on One Requirement](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP101_physics-closes-rest-is-engineering.html): The breeder's power balance is closed and reproduces; the burner has a reproducible closing point contingent on a single named requirement.
- [Public Dose Closes, With Room to Spare](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP102_public-dose-closes.html): The offsite dose requirement is met by an ordinary detritiation system, far inside demonstrated practice.
- [The Burner's Scheduled-Replacement Waste Is Essentially Zero](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP103_burner-replacement-waste-near-zero.html): A first wall that lasts a century of full-power operation is a first wall you almost never replace.
- [Why Not Fully Aneutronic: The x >= 0.45 Redesign](https://www.kronosfusionenergy.com/whitepapers/KFE-WP104_why-not-fully-aneutronic.html): The burner could be made far cleaner &mdash; but true near-aneutronic operation is a different machine, and the record says so.
